31429-washo-religion.title: Washo Religion
31429-washo-religion.creator: Unknown
31429-washo-religion.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. In the mythology, Water Baby figures as the creature responsible for the many lakes of the eastern Sierra. Killed and scalped by the rascally Damalali, Water Baby commands the waters of the area to rise until the weasel returns the scalp to avoid drowning. The waters left in mountain valleys as the flood receded formed the lakes.

arxiv-2006-15622.title: Massive particle pair production and oscillation in Friedman Universe: reheating energy and entropy, and cold dark matter
arxiv-2006-15622.creator: She-Sheng Xue
arxiv-2006-15622.description: Abstract Suppose that the early Universe starts with a cosmological Λ \Lambda -term originating from quantum spacetime at the Planck scale. Dark energy drives inflation and reheating by reducing its value for massive particle-antiparticle pairs production and oscillation, resulting in a holographic and massive pair plasma state.

arxiv-2109-08666.title: Learning Sparse Graph with Minimax Concave Penalty under Gaussian Markov Random Fields
arxiv-2109-08666.creator: TATSUYA KOYAKUMARU 1, MASAHIRO YUKAWA 1, EDUARDO PAVEZ 2, ANTONIO ORTEGA. 2
arxiv-2109-08666.description: Abstract This paper presents a convex-analytic framework to learn sparse graphs from data. While our problem formulation is inspired by an extension of the graphical lasso using the so-called combinatorial graph Laplacian framework, a key difference is the use of a nonconvex alternative to the ℓ 1 \ell_{1} norm to attain graphs with better interpretability.

arxiv-2109-11017.title: On the Fate of Interstellar Objects Captured by our Solar System Journal: The Planetary Science Journal
arxiv-2109-11017.creator: Kevin J. Napier, Fred C. Adams, Konstantin Batygin
arxiv-2109-11017.description: Abstract With the recent discoveries of interstellar objects ‘Oumuamua and Borisov traversing the solar system, understanding the dynamics of interstellar objects is more pressing than ever. These detections have highlighted the possibility that captured interstellar material could be trapped in our solar system.

arxiv-2208-05793.title: Predicting nonlinear optical scattering with physics-driven neural networks
arxiv-2208-05793.creator: C. Gigli, A. Saba, A.B. Ayoub, D. Psaltis
arxiv-2208-05793.description: Abstract Deep neural networks trained on physical losses are emerging as promising surrogates of nonlinear numerical solvers. These tools can predict solutions of Maxwell’s equations and compute gradients of output fields with respect to the material and geometrical properties in millisecond times which makes them attractive for inverse design or inverse scattering applications.

arxiv-2503-23353.title: Object Isolated Attention for Consistent Story Visualization
arxiv-2503-23353.creator: Xiangyang Luo 1,2 , Junhao Cheng 3 , Yifan Xie 1 , Xin Zhang 1 , Tao Feng 1,2 , Zhou Liu 1 , Fei Ma 1 2 , Fei Yu 1
arxiv-2503-23353.description: Abstract Open-ended story visualization is a challenging task that involves generating coherent image sequences from a given storyline. One of the main difficulties is maintaining character consistency while creating natural and contextually fitting scenes—an area where many existing methods struggle.

arxiv-2510-01348.title: Kilometer-Scale GNSS-Denied UAV Navigation via Heightmap Gradients: A Winning System from the SPRIN-D Challenge
arxiv-2510-01348.creator: Michal Werner, David Čapek, Tomáš Musil, Ondřej Franěk, Tomáš Báča, Martin Saska
arxiv-2510-01348.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Michal Werner, David Čapek, Tomáš Musil, Ondřej Franěk, Tomáš Báča, Martin Saska. Reliable long-range flight of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) in GNSS-denied environments is challenging: integrating odometry leads to drift, loop closures are unavailable in previously unseen areas and embedded platforms provide limited computational power. We present a fully onboard UAV system developed for the SPRIN-D Funke Fully Autonomous Flight Challenge, which required 9 km long-range waypoint navigation below 25 m AGL (Above Ground Level) without GNSS or prior dense mapping.

arxiv-2601-22917.title: Deep in the Jungle: Towards Automating Chimpanzee Population Estimation
arxiv-2601-22917.creator: Tom Raynes, Otto Brookes, Timm Haucke, Lukas Bösch, Anne-Sophie Crunchant, Hjalmar Kühl, Sara Beery, Majid Mirmehdi, Tilo Burghardt
arxiv-2601-22917.description: Abstract The estimation of abundance and density in unmarked populations of great apes relies on statistical frameworks that require animal-to-camera distance measurements. In practice, acquiring these distances depends on labour-intensive manual interpretation of animal observations across large camera trap video corpora.

pmc-10505507.title: Metastatic osseous disease of unknown primary origin: a case report and review of literature
pmc-10505507.creator: Alleyna Dougherty, Lauren Moore, Lori Atkins
pmc-10505507.description: Cancer of unknown primary (CUP) is a heterogeneous group of metastatic tumors in the absence of a clinically identifiable site. We describe the case of a 66-year-old female with an extensive history of non-specific imaging concerning for malignancy who did not undergo further workup and in whom a diagnosis of CUP was made.

pmc-10586371.title: Comparison between Spatially Resolved Airborne Flux Measurements and Emission Inventories of Volatile Organic Compounds in Los Angeles
pmc-10586371.creator: Eva Y. Pfannerstill, Caleb Arata, Qindan Zhu, Benjamin C. Schulze, Roy Woods, Colin Harkins, Rebecca H. Schwantes, Brian C. McDonald, John H. Seinfeld, Anthony Bucholtz, Ronald C. Cohen, Allen H. Goldstein
pmc-10586371.description: Los Angeles is a major hotspot for ozone and particulate matter air pollution in the United States. Ozone and PM2.5 in this region have not improved substantially for the past decade, despite a reduction in vehicular emissions of their precursors, NOx and volatile organic compounds (VOCs).

pmc-11438444.title: Link Between Obsessive-Compulsive Disorder and ApoE Gene Polymorphisms[Letter]
pmc-11438444.creator: Luyi Xu, Cheng Mei
pmc-11438444.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). e commend the authors for their work and make a number of recommendations. First, we would like to talk about the inclusion criteria. In this study, the distinction between early-onset OCD and late-onset OCD was made solely on the basis of a single variable, age of onset (split by whether or not the person had reached the age of 15), which is prone to selection bias.

pmc-11495838.title: Giant Mesothelial Cyst of the Spermatic Cord: A Report of a Rare Case
pmc-11495838.creator: Ramki Arunachalam Ganesh, Jesu Pencilin Yesuvadiyan, Karthikeyan Selvaraj
pmc-11495838.description: Mesothelial cysts are uncommon benign lesions formed by mesothelial cells that line the serosal surfaces of many organs. It is commonly found in the peritoneum and less commonly in the pleura; when found in the spermatic cord, they are exceedingly rare. These cysts usually appear as painless lumps in the inguinal or scrotal area and often remain asymptomatic.

pmc-11673627.title: Thyroid and cardiovascular diseases
pmc-11673627.creator: Sinem Başak TAN ÖKSÜZ, Mustafa ŞAHİN
pmc-11673627.description: The thyroid gland is one of the major regulator organs of hemostasis in the human body, controlling the functioning of numerous systems. Thyroid hormones exert a modulating effect on the cardiovascular system in particular, ensuring optimal functioning within the normal range.

pmc-11676901.title: Physical Performance of Geriatric Women and Its Impact on Fracture Risk and Bone Mineral Density Assessed with Radiofrequency Echographic Multispectrometry (REMS)
pmc-11676901.creator: Elena Bischoff, Stanislava Popova-Belova, Fabian Bischoff, Nikola Kirilov
pmc-11676901.description: Background: This study aimed to investigate the impact of physical performance of geriatric women on their fracture risk and bone mineral density (BMD) assessed with radiofrequency echographic multispectrometry (REMS). Methods: We conducted a prospective observational study to assess the physical performance, BMD and fracture risk in 182 geriatric women aged 60 years and older.

pmc-12606736.title: Serum Fourier-Transform Infrared Spectroscopy with Machine Learning for Screening of Pediatric Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia: A Proof-of-Concept Study
pmc-12606736.creator: Aneta Kowal, Paweł Jakubczyk, Wioletta Bal, Zuzanna Piasecka, Klaudia Szuler, Kornelia Łach, Katarzyna Sopel, Józef Cebulski, Radosław Chaber, Tadeusz Robak
pmc-12606736.description: Simple SummaryAcute lymphoblastic leukemia is the most common pediatric malignancy and its diagnosis still relies on bone-marrow evaluation, an invasive and technically demanding procedure. There is ongoing interest in developing minimally invasive methods that could support earlier recognition of the disease.

pmc-12619479.title: The VCPKMT-VCP-HDAC1 axis inhibits colorectal cancer by conferring sensitivity to ferroptosis
pmc-12619479.creator: Cijun Huang, Jinlong Lin, Shuidan Xu, Yongrui Lv, Jiewei Chen, Jinghua Cao, Dan Xie, Fengwei Wang
pmc-12619479.description: BackgroundFerroptosis, a regulated form of cell death driven by lipid peroxidation and iron dysregulation, plays a critical role in tumor suppression. The expression of certain genes determine ferroptosis sensitivity and may serve as biomarkers to identify patients who could benefit from ferroptosis-promoting therapies.

pmc-12640604.title: A Case of Recurrent Multiple Uterine Fibroids Associated with Hereditary Leiomyomatosis and Renal Cell Carcinoma (HLRCC): Insights into Fumarate Hydratase (FH) Deficiency
pmc-12640604.creator: Wan Li, Shu Bao, Jie Duan
pmc-12640604.description: Hereditary leiomyomatosis and renal cell carcinoma (HLRCC) is a rare genetic disorder caused by mutations in fumarate hydratase (FH) gene. The main manifestations include cutaneous leiomyoma, uterine leiomyoma, and type 2 papillary renal cell carcinoma (PRCC2). This case report is about a 37-year-old patient with multiple uterine leiomyomas. The patient had recurred within a short period after both previous myomectomies.

pmc-13204120.title: Incorporation of Hydroxyeicosatetraenoic Acid Isomers into Macrophage Phospholipids Reveals Class-Specific Distribution
pmc-13204120.creator: Alvaro Garrido, Patricia Monge, Natalia Pérez, María A. Balboa, Jesús Balsinde
pmc-13204120.description: Phospholipid fatty acid incorporation and remodeling are central processes through which immune cells adapt their membranes during activation. Macrophages are known to integrate oxidized fatty acids into phospholipids, yet the principles governing this distribution remain incompletely defined. Hydroxyeicosatetraenoic acids (HETEs) are abundant products generated during inflammation, and their integration into membrane phospholipids may influence signaling, trafficking, and membrane organization.

pmc-13670677.title: Routine versus postoperative CRP/CT guided selective diverting ileostomy after laparoscopic low anterior resection for rectal cancer: a comparative randomized controlled trial
pmc-13670677.creator: Ahmed M. Moaz, Khaled E. Barakat, Walid Elshazly, Yasser Zaki, Amr Badawy, Bassem Kh. Hegazy, Ahmed M. Mohieldein
pmc-13670677.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundDiverting ileostomy is routinely used to protect the anastomosis after laparoscopic low anterior resection (LAR) for rectal cancer, but it exposes most patients to stoma-related morbidity even though only a minority develop a true anastomotic leak.

pmc-13682445.title: Dysregulated AKT signaling reprograms osteosarcoma to drive selective reliance on EP300
pmc-13682445.creator: Ian M. Delahunty, Stephanie Nance, Yang Zhang, Francois Lamoureux, Qi Liu, William C. Wright, K. Elaine Ritter, Noha A.M. Shendy, Bénédicte Brounais-Le Roye, Sandra J. Kietlinska, Mohammad A. Mohammad Nezhady, Yuan Feng, Barbara De Kegel, Matthew G. Rees, Mustafa Kocak, Ashish B. George, Meifen Lu,
pmc-13682445.description: Here, Delahunty et al. identify that EP300 controls the growth of AKT-dysregulated osteosarcoma cells by regulating expression of state-specific genetic dependencies. AKT inhibitors synergize with EP300 degraders to suppress osteosarcoma growth in vitro and in vivo. These agents positively combine across cancer cells in a manner dependent on control of protein synthesis.

uslaw-usc-t36-s170503.title: 36 U.S.C. § 170503 — Purposes
uslaw-usc-t36-s170503.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t36-s170503.description: United States Code, Title 36 (Patriotic And National Observances, Ceremonies, And Organizations); Part B (Organizations); Chapter 1705 (Polish Legion Of American Veterans, U.S.A.). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. The purposes of the corporation are as provided in its articles of incorporation. The corporation shall function as a veterans’ and patriotic organization as authorized by the laws of each State in which it.
